selection: For each local rank, minimize absolute log ratio of question-mean activation MSE using only validation. Break exact ties by smaller shared rank. Never choose on KL/NLL or test data.
near_error_label: Only when relative validation MSE gap <= 0.10; test MSE gap is also always reported. Matching mean error does not match every question or prove an independent functional effect.
scope: Secondary exploratory comparison. Fixed after GPU smoke execution but before reading any locality scientific outcomes; independent of primary same-rank contrast.
